name: Multivariate Gradient Magnitude
aliases: L2 Norm of Structure Tensor for Local Change
Multivariate Gradient Magnitude (L2 Norm of Tensor G)
definition: A first-derivative measure for multivariate data (e.g., RGB color) that captures the total amount of local change across all data components, used as an axis in multidimensional transfer functions.
summary: Multivariate Gradient Magnitude is a scalar measure of local change in multidimensional volume data, distinguished by using the rotationally invariant L2 norm of the structure tensor rather than principal eigenvalues.
